branding_seo_description: Menzies brand guidelines for logo usage, clear space, wordmark spelling, and typography with Fraunces display and Maple Mono for UI and body text.
branding_intro: How we use the Menzies mark, name, and type on this store and related products. Stick to these assets so the brand stays quiet and consistent.
branding_logo_blurb: The Menzies mark is a blue-to-violet gradient SVG. Prefer the SVG at /logo.svg for sharp rendering at every size.
branding_logo_clear_space_blurb: Keep empty space around the mark of at least about one quarter of the logo width on each side. Do not crowd it with other logos or dense UI chrome.
branding_logo_do_keep_ratio: Keep the original square aspect ratio.
branding_logo_do_use_svg: Use the SVG on light or dark surfaces with enough contrast.
branding_logo_dont_stretch: Do not stretch or squash the mark.
branding_logo_dont_recolor: Do not replace the blue-violet gradient with flat or arbitrary colors.
branding_wordmark_blurb: Spell the name Menzies in title case. Pair the mark with the Fraunces wordmark in nav and footers. The product line is Software worth opening.
branding_type_blurb: Type ships with Wash UI. Display headings use Fraunces. UI, body, and mono use Maple Mono (loaded as both --font-sans and --font-mono).
branding_type_display_blurb: Section titles, hero lines, and the Menzies wordmark. Use the font-display utility.
branding_type_body_blurb: Navigation, paragraphs, buttons, and code. Default UI face from Wash UI styles.

extensions_seo_title: Signed offline face recognition for Menzies Gallery
extensions_seo_description: Optional offline face recognition for Menzies Gallery. Install it from the signed catalog, keep updates manual, and leave every photo on your computer.
extensions_intro: Extensions add optional capability to Menzies desktop apps. Gallery is the first app on this catalog. Each package is signed, versioned, and installed only after you choose it.
extensions_privacy_body: Extension packages do not upload your photos or other personal files. Gallery keeps images on this computer. A registry check downloads only the signed catalog, and an install downloads only the package you accept.
extensions_offline_body: After a package is installed, Gallery uses the local copy. Face detection and grouping run on this computer. Photos are not uploaded. The app does not need the network again until you check for an update.
extensions_updates_body: New extensions are never installed silently. The first install is a click in the app. After that, each extension is Manual or Automatic. Manual is the default. Automatic downloads a newer signed version only after that first install. Older versions are rejected unless a developer turns on a local override that is not shown in the app. Revoked packages are listed in the catalog, which is cached briefly so a revocation can take effect quickly. Package files use versioned URLs that can be cached for a long time.
extensions_platforms_body: Linux x86_64 is the published face recognition target. macOS and Windows package slots are reserved and are not published. Gallery offers a package only when it matches the system you are using.
extensions_install_body: Open Gallery on your computer. Choose Extensions in the title bar, after the app name. Install downloads the signed package only after you click Install. Then enable recognition. That switch stays off until you choose it. A folder on this computer remains available as an offline fallback for a package you already have.
extensions_face_body: Face recognition {version} is available for {target}. The download is {size}. Install it from Gallery, then enable recognition. Photos stay on your computer. Updates are manual until you choose automatic for this extension.
extensions_models_body: The package contains YuNet face_detection_yunet_2023mar.onnx (MIT, Copyright 2020 Shiqi Yu) and SFace face_recognition_sface_2021dec.onnx (Apache-2.0), both from OpenCV Zoo, plus ONNX Runtime 1.28 (MIT, Copyright Microsoft Corporation) for Linux x86_64. Gallery loads that runtime only after the signed package is installed, and it turns runtime telemetry off. This is face detection and embeddings, not a language model.
extensions_catalog_address: Gallery downloads the catalog and the publisher key from these addresses.
extensions_registry_body: The catalog is a signed JSON document. Gallery pins the publisher public key and rejects a file that fails the signature, a downgrade of the catalog sequence, or a host other than menzies.mariesta.com. A developer may point registryUrl at loopback for a local test. That override is not shown in the app. Publisher key id: {keyId}.
